issues.title: Actual Tutor Core v0.2 package is not accessible
decisionImpact: Tutor Core package ID and exact version manifest
spoken-turn, caption, transcript, and adult-review evidence mapping
issues.requiredResolution: Mount or attach the actual package, verify its artifact hash, then run the Tutor-Core compatibility probes. Do not use a summary as a substitute.

issues.title: Session 4 duplicates adult-private note bodies in controls and actionLog
issues.requiredResolution: Store the body only in ParentTeacherPrivateRecord; public control state and its append-only log retain noteRef, category, actor, and timestamp only.

issues.title: Unsupported or corrupt Study-UX workspace silently resets
issues.requiredResolution: Quarantine the raw workspace with a fixed reason code and show recoverable UI; never replace it with an empty workspace before explicit migration or adult reset.

issues.title: Packages expose parallel event vocabularies
issues.requiredResolution: Persist only Session 1 hyphenated StudySessionEvent values. Treat Session 2 snake_case events, Session 3 UI events, and Session 4 audit events as adapter inputs or projections.

issues.title: Canonical ResumePoint is not sufficient for exact sub-step refresh recovery
issues.requiredResolution: Keep ResumePoint canonical and add a versioned, integrity-checked cursor sidecar behind responseDraftRef. Raw draft text stays in a separate authorized device-local vault.

issues.title: Study-UX segment identifiers are not bound to canonical LessonSegment IDs
issues.requiredResolution: Build each UX lesson from a validated LessonStudyPlan and use its SegmentId values. Do not persist prototype labels as a second segment identity.

issues.title: Session 1 timer enum conflates visibility and metric presentation
issues.requiredResolution: Use Student-UX visibility visible|minimal|hidden as one axis and count-up|count-down|milestone as a separate metric axis; retire the conflated enum through a versioned adapter.

issues.title: Accessibility and accommodation shapes cannot losslessly represent Study-UX preferences
issues.requiredResolution: Promote structured motion, audio, read-aloud, speech-input, transcript, keyboard, and required accommodation effects. Preserve Session 3 learner UX and actual Tutor Core media capabilities.

issues.title: Core-authored retrieval and reteaching outcomes have no verified bridge
issues.requiredResolution: Map actual Tutor Core v0.2 outputs to LearningEvidence, RetrievalEvidence, and StudentSkillReview without deriving authority from accuracy or Study Engine heuristics.

issues.title: Review queue has no result-return transition
issues.requiredResolution: Add a versioned review-attempt result command carrying ReviewId, RetrievalAttemptId, SessionId, EvidenceId, and idempotency key; transition pending to completed only once.

issues.title: Recommendation lifecycle is not represented end to end
issues.requiredResolution: Use proposed|accepted|rejected|superseded|expired for actionable recommendations. insufficient_data and manual_review are dispositions, not accept/reject proposals.

issues.title: A simple first-wins precedence chain cannot represent conflicting hard constraints
issues.requiredResolution: Use the approved constraint-reduction policy in canonical-decisions.v1.json. Infeasible safety/accommodation/parent intersections route to manual_review.

issues.title: Namespaced metadata extension values can carry prohibited sensitive content
issues.requiredResolution: Apply per-namespace schemas and deny sensitive keys/values at student-safe boundaries; never treat generic JsonValue validation as privacy validation.

issues.title: Prototype localStorage combines raw drafts and transcripts with canonical-looking state
issues.requiredResolution: Split canonical low-detail state from a separately authorized local draft/transcript vault with explicit retention. Never emit raw content to Study Engine events or evidence.

issues.title: Session 2 can echo free-text into learner-facing coach messages
issues.requiredResolution: Retire direct rendering at integration. Session 2 emits reason-coded intents; Tutor Core v0.2 renders and safety-checks final spoken/captioned text.

issues.title: Romeo supportRef is untyped and credential detection is key-name based
issues.requiredResolution: Resolve supportRef to a typed VersionedReference<StudyPlanId> or actual Tutor Core support reference after package inspection; scan or reject free-text/URL surfaces under an approved intake policy.

issues.title: Household time zone is repeated but has no shared source-of-truth context
issues.requiredResolution: Supply one authorized household IANA zone, store the zone used with each learner-local date, and never recompute historical dates after a zone change.

issues.title: Study-UX fixtures do not carry canonical SkillId values
issues.requiredResolution: Bind each production UX task to a verified canonical LessonSegment and Tutor Core SkillId. Do not derive a skill ID from display text or fixture position.

issues.title: Required accommodations have no typed requiredness or operational effects
issues.requiredResolution: Add catalog-backed requiredness and typed constraint/effect fields. Compose required constraints; route infeasible intersections to manual-review.

issues.title: Session 2 hold override can preserve a duration above an adult hard cap
issues.requiredResolution: Apply safety, accommodation, and adult hard clamps before any hold or manual target. The fixture current=30, hardMax=20, mode=hold must resolve to at most 20, never maintain 30.

issues.title: Session 4 parent-only note visibility cannot map to authorized-adults-only without widening access
issues.requiredResolution: Preserve parent-only material in a narrower adult-private sidecar until the canonical private contract carries an explicit audience scope.

issues.title: Parent-control events lack event identity, actor, version, and retry semantics
issues.requiredResolution: Introduce a versioned command envelope, stable command/event identity, actor reference, expected revision, and replay conflict rule before projecting controls.

issues.title: Session 4 recommendation acceptance directly rewrites hard guardrails
issues.requiredResolution: Acceptance records a RecommendationDecision only. Any hard-limit change requires a separate explicit control command validated against safety and accommodation constraints.

issues.title: Romeo dueDate is projected as an offset timestamp
issues.requiredResolution: Keep Romeo dueDate as ISODate. Add a scheduled offset instant only when one is independently authorized; never invent local midnight.

issues.title: Schema registry exposes student-safe and adult-private kinds without an audience capability
issues.requiredResolution: Annotate registered kinds with data class and require an adult-private capability before parsing, projecting, or exporting parent-teacher-private records.

issues.title: Session 2 transitions preserve unknown state keys
issues.requiredResolution: Validate or project through an explicit allowlist. Reject or quarantine polluted state carrying rawAnswer, transcript, privateNote, or any unknown field.

issues.title: Same-day retrieval retry has no not-before safety rule
issues.requiredResolution: Require support or reteaching plus a session or break boundary and define an authorized retryNotBefore policy. Until then same-day failures route to manual-review and no clock time is invented.

issues.title: Opaque identifier validators use incompatible alphabets and length limits
issues.requiredResolution: Validate at the Session 1 maximum 128-byte opaque boundary and preserve bytes. Provisional consumers must widen validators or use a reversible external-reference table; never normalize.

issues.title: Three grade-band vocabularies differ
issues.requiredResolution: Persist Session 1 elementary-3-5|middle-6-8|high-9-12. Map Session 2 values only at its input boundary and keep human UX labels display-only.

issues.title: Contracts and Engine ZIP entries use backslash separators
issues.requiredResolution: Normalize separators to slash only in archive readers. Do not rewrite either hash-verified Wave 1 ZIP.

issues.title: Wave 1 packages use separate manifests, import suffix styles, and test environments
issues.requiredResolution: Keep algorithms/contracts runtime-dependency-free, use one final-assembly workspace lockfile, and keep React, jsdom, Axe, and Playwright in the browser/test package only.

issues.title: Logical package IDs are not declared in Wave 1 manifests
issues.requiredResolution: Use the logical IDs approved in canonical-decisions.v1.json; add publishable package manifests only during an authorized assembly session.

issues.title: Production persistence, authentication, authorization, retention, and deployment remain out of scope
issues.requiredResolution: Obtain production-owner privacy/security review in a later authorized wave. This audit makes no production write.

issues.title: Romeo intake origin, host allowlist, retention, and deletion policy are not production-approved
issues.requiredResolution: Approve a credential-free metadata intake and governance policy before any external assignment persistence or fetching.
